renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Only knowing counts. If you've really learned, you should be blessed as a worker or a teacher — even if you have no other qualifications, and even if someone with all the qualifications but no knowing gets blessed instead of you. It won't count.

Once a teacher has handed you his job, he doesn't get in trouble for not starting new students. But before that handover, skipping initiations IS his chain — through the wrong of it, through the bond of the job, through the one who gives the angels' rank. So: get blessed. Then, to become one with your mantra's god, do the knowing-vow for six months — chant every day, feed the fire, worship extra hard. Then, when you've become that, you're allowed to start students. Here's how: don't start the ones who aren't ready, and don't skip the ones who are. Even test the ones you already started, when you teach them. If you find out someone faked their way in — let it slide, knowingly. And do the god-worship big, the way a blessed one does.

paragraphs.text: Know your stuff? Get blessed — worker track or teacher track. Badges don't matter, prior blessings don't matter. Knowing's the whole ticket.

Handed the job over? Then you're off the hook for not starting newbies. Before that? Skipping starts IS the chain — via the wrongness, the job-bond, the angel-rank-giver. So: get blessed. Six months, daily grind — chant, burn, worship extra — knowledge-vow for mantra-god merge. Made of That? Now you can start people. Rules: no unready starts, no skipping the ready, test even your own grads, clock the fakers and let it go knowingly. Worship big — blessed-style.
